name: @intellectual-frontiers/integrations-x12
description: The X12 envelope and acknowledgement skeleton of Integrations: the entries of X12 and of the HIPAA 5010 and purchasing transaction sets with their licence as data, a codec for the fixed-width ISA envelope and its ISA, GS and ST levels, control counts checked as findings, TA1 and 999 made and read, and a loader of a schema from the user's own transcription of a licensed guide. It embeds no standard.

scripts.verify: tsc -p tsconfig.json && bun ../tools/mizan-check.ts --root spec-kit && bun ../libraries/src/check.ts --root spec-kit --level L1 && bun tools/check.ts && bun test suite/ && bun tools/pack.ts --check
